body.statement: For every \(\vartheta_n=(L_n,D_n)\in\Theta_n\) under the balanced rank-one one-block L-mask assumptions and every deterministic \(A_n\) satisfying treated support, normalization, nonnegativity, and diffuseness, \[\Pr_{\mathbb P_{\vartheta,n},\Xi_n,\Zeta_n}\{\tau_{A,n}\in\mathrm{CI}_{A,n}\}\ge1-\alpha.\] The half-length is at most \(a_n\widehat R_{\alpha/2,n}+z_{1-\alpha/4}\sigma\lVert A_n\rVert_F\); this is a coverage result from nuclear--operator duality, not an optimal-length assertion.
body.justification: Nuclear/operator duality transfers the global counterfactual certificate to a pre-specified diffuse ATT, while the independent treated-cell noise is covered separately.
body.gap: Functional-specific papers derive sharper tailored laws; this result is solely a coverage-valid duality corollary.
body.consumer: Applied staggered-adoption studies can reuse the global matrix uncertainty set for one valid weighted ATT interval.
